verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual says SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID or Touch ID. That matches every element of the story: hardware-backed storage, a secure enclave, and biometric protection. Keys can also be generated inside the app. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and deeper documentation of the enclave key workflow (e.g. supported key types, import vs. generate on enclave).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics

citations.quote: For extra security SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.
You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.
